text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: (Thank you. And farewell, Princess.)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(I will never forget what you gave me. 
First—I'll repay you with my running.)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"Behold, my well-honed 'Holy Sword'! May 
our future be as bright—as its brilliant 
gleam."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Fourteen blades, the legacy of Durandal! 
Hyaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: This... running form... How magnificent...

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Durandal!! Following the 'Sprinters 
Stakes', she decisively cuts down the 
'Mile Championship' as well!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Behold the cutting edge of a masterwork 
blade! It has sliced right through even 
Fine Motion's run!"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
There is nothing my Holy Sword cannot cut. 
And—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
In the time we spent sprinting, I have not 
a single lingering regret!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOAAAHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She finally achieved it. Back-to-back 
sprint GⅠ victories, and consecutive title 
defenses.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
As expected of my King. It was truly a 
wise decision. Victory... is ours.
choice_data_list:
Yeah. You truly are the holy sword, 
Durandal.

Yeah. You truly are the holy sword, 
Durandal.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Gracious words indeed. And if I am a 
treasured sword, then you, who wield it, 
must be—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I am the supreme king standing atop the 
Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOAAAHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Surrounded by countless cheers of praise 
for us... I can feel it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'm not a real king. Yet, amid this fever 
pitch, we were undoubtedly royalty.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Durandal, that was magnificent. It is my 
total defeat. And...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Though I suffered defeat... you have my 
gratitude. Seeing such an incredible run 
at the very end will inspire me for the 
rest of my life.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Princess, forgive me. However, what I wish 
to show you is...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Aside from this run, there is one more 
thing. Please, behold the ultimate bond 
between master and servant.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Durandal walked up in front of me, bowed, 
and—"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-dono, I have finally realized. 
What our immortal treasure truly is.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Along with today's glory—please accept 
this.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The Holy Sword is now supreme and 
invincible. Yet we cannot say for certain 
that a day will not come when this 
radiance fades.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Even so, there are things that never fade. 
And that is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I felt like I had a vague idea of what it 
was. And that was...
choice_data_list:
Memories of the time we spent together, 
huh...

Memories of the time we spent together, I 
guess...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As sovereign and knight, Durandal and I 
sprinted through this very moment with 
everything we had.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if the day comes when the nation 
falls, these shining memories alone 
will...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: No—it's not just a memory.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
The treasure we gained is not mere 
sentimentality; it is something far more 
steadfast.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Endless power... Perhaps that is an 
illusion that everyone yearns for, yet no 
one can ever grasp.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Even so, even should I, the sword, be 
broken—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"My King's days as a Trainer will 
continue. Carrying a 'new sword' once 
more."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
No matter how the eras change, you will 
remain the same valiant king as you are 
now. Because—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Because I possess "immense confidence" 
that blossomed from fighting alongside 
you.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Though the holy sword decays, the 
throne remains. Even if I cannot stay by 
your side...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
You will surely never lose your 
"confidence."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I, Durandal... even should the day come 
when I can no longer runâ

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Transforming into a sword called 
"decisiveness," it will live on in your 
heart forever.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: This is—an immortal treasure. And...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
This is my idea of the ideal master and 
servant.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She wasn't a true knight from the very 
beginning. However...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After undergoing countless training 
sessions and fierce battles with rivals...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume who yearns to be a knight 
now—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She had become a true knight, worthy of 
astounding even the Princess.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I... see... So this is a true 
master-servant bond...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
No matter what happens to herself, a heart 
wishing for the King's future. And...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"To possess the virtue to be loved so 
deeply, and the courage to lead others..."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Durandal. Truly, thank you!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Right at the very end, the two of you 
taught me such a wonderful lesson!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Fine Motion bowed politely. And so—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Durandal became the Holy Sword standing 
atop the sprinting world."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And on the day of departure—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Durandal, Trainer. Take care. The days I 
spent with the two of you. And...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
All those days spent running, laughing, 
and learning alongside so many wonderful 
Umamusume...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: "I will never forget. And then..."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I'd love to run with you again someday!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Yes—we eagerly await that day from the 
bottom of our hearts. Both my King, and 
myself.
choice_data_list:
Yeah, makes you want to run again, doesn't 
it!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Though having said that, there's still 
some leftover work, so I'll be coming back 
to Tracen Academy for a while...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: That might come true in time. And then...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to look for a way to somehow get 
re-enrolled at Tracen Academy too!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I just don't think it's right to sever our 
ties. After all, the days I spent 
competing with Durandal were...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"If she could return on official duty, 
that should benefit the country as well."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
――! If you can return, that would be 
wonderful. Many will surely rejoice.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. Well then, it's about time—I 
head off.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
It's painful to part ways, but... for now, 
we must walk our own paths.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Good day, Durandal. The greatest 
knight—that I have ever known.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Such gracious words. Princess, may your 
journey be safe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Exchanging unspoken, boundless feelings 
simply by gazing into each other's eyes—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Screeech!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Princess Fine Motion departed for Ireland.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: There she goes, Trainer-dono. However—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
The battle is not over. New Umamusume will 
continue to charge at us, one after 
another.
choice_data_list: Yeah, I can't afford to lose.
Yeah, we can't afford to lose.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Yes, we must protect it. Our nation, our 
pride. And—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
The throne of the sprint world. For as 
long as my strength lasts—by the King's 
side.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: And then—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
And if I manage to protect it to the very 
end, then, um...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I am waiting. Praise me as much as you 
like.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The knight Durandal. Her aspirations 
reach ever higher, and—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her desire is stronger than anyone's. Such 
an unyielding Umamusume.
